why: Search Console (Aug 5 to Nov 4): impressions grew about sixfold while CTR stayed near 0.65%. Most guides had 3 to 4 inbound links, 38 had no personal byline, and only 7 linked to Device Check.

/tips/phone-screen-problems, /tips/battery-charging-problems, /tips/laptop-problems, /tips/game-console-problems. Each row restates its guide's own summary; no new prices, statistics or repair claims.
Every guide links to its finder (or the Repair Library) and to Device Check.
tips.html gains a 'Find it by symptom' section; about.html gains a 'Guides from the same bench' section.
sitemap.xml and llms.txt list the four finders. Guide lastmod and dateModified values were left alone because guide body copy did not change.
Added a dated update: Article schema only, author entity, finders, topic focus, pace.
